ns2:course.label: Intro Audiol & Hear Disorders
ns2:course.description: Review of the history of audiology as a profession; study of symptoms, causes, and treatment of hearing losses; and principles and application of basic audiometry. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of Instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Consent of Instructor.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one lab and one lecture-discussion section.
